title: The Ready meal on the table
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：ready　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ready 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the operator wrote of ① a ready meal on the table in the log, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② readier than the one named there the year before. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the operator, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the ready ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the readiest meal on the table anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the log for June 1947 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too ready to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainee who had come to help; the ready ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a ready helper in the yard, and said that no trainee in his right mind would call it ⑥ as ready as the helper in the yard they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was ready or not, and he said so.

By 1960 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something ready, and nothing besides. The trainee from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite ready; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the ready ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1963, year after year, she wrote of another ready meal on the table in the same log, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ readier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The readiest helper in the yard in the whole station, she said in 1965, was the one she could never quite name; the ready ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 准备好（前置定语 a ready meal on the table：1953 年操作员在运行日志里记下的那件准备好的饭菜）
B. adj. 准备好／乐意（比较级 readier than：文中两处，一处比桌上备好的饭菜，一处比预想）
C. adj. 准备好／乐意（最高级 the readiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 准备好（表语 too ready to do：母亲觉得它太准备好，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 乐意（前置定语 a ready helper in the yard：叔叔把整件事称作一桩乐意的人）
F. adj. 乐意（同级比较 as ready as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩院里乐意搭手的人相比）
G. adj. 乐意（后置定语 something ready：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 乐意（受程度副词修饰 quite ready：那位实习生的评价）

items.q: a ready meal on the table
the readiest meal on the table anybody
a ready helper in the yard
The readiest helper in the yard in

answers.why: ready 意为“准备好”，1953 年操作员在运行日志里记下的是“一件准备好的饭菜”，此处作前置定语 a ready meal on the table。
ready 意为“准备好”，此处用比较级 readier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
ready 意为“准备好”，运行日志上 六月 那行字说它是机房里最准备好的一件，故用最高级 the readiest meal on the table。
ready 意为“准备好”，母亲认为这件东西“太准备好了，谁也用不上”，too ready to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
ready 意为“乐意”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩乐意的人”，此处作前置定语 a ready helper in the yard。
ready 意为“乐意”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩院里乐意搭手的人一样乐意”，同级比较用 as ready as。
ready 意为“乐意”，运行日志上那半行字要的是“乐意的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something ready。
ready 意为“乐意”，邻机房来的那位实习生认为这套计划“相当乐意”，quite 修饰原级 ready。
ready 意为“乐意”，1963 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要乐意”，故用比较级 readier than。
ready 意为“乐意”，母亲 1965 年说的是“整个机房里最乐意的那一桩”，故用最高级 the readiest helper in the yard。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1953 年，操作员在运行日志里记下了一件准备好的饭菜。（a ready meal on the table）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更准备好。（readier than …）
母亲觉得它太准备好，谁也用不上。（too ready to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩乐意的人。（a ready helper in the yard）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩院里乐意搭手的人一样乐意。（as ready as …）
到了 1960 年，运行日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件乐意的东西。（something ready）
answers: In 1953 the operator wrote of a ready meal on the table in the log.
Everybody said it was readier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too ready to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a ready helper in the yard.
He said nobody would call it as ready as the helper in the yard they had once had.
By 1960 the log asked for nothing but something ready.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ready 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the operator wrote of a ready meal on the table in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the readiest meal on the table in the station, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too ready to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a ready helper in the yard, and nobody argued with him.
The trainee from the next station called the plan quite ready, and everybody laughed.
The ready ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
